reason: Game Plan Tech is not a game studio despite the name — Exa confirms it is a ~58-person federal IT consulting and services firm (SDVOSB, McLean/Reston VA, founded 2023, gameplan.tech) selling cloud/AI engineering to government teams, so it fails Ben Cole's vertical (US funded PC/console game studios entering full production) and is itself a services/consultancy seller; every live posting (Cloud Infrastructure Engineer on GCP 'in a federal environment', Security Engineer/ISSE citing FedRAMP/DISA IL5/NIST 800-53, Technical Project Manager requiring Pentagon travel and a Secret clearance) describes billable delivery staff for government contracts, not an unowned studio technical-operations layer.
